what: The owner's own face take (Note 9 front camera, 11-27), read by the web pilot's face tracker (MediaPipe face landmarker 0.10.14, float16 model, on the CPU) at 15 frames a second from a 640-wide picture, not mirrored. Numbers only: no picture is kept. Per frame: [frame number, the raw face (rawKeys, each divided by rawScale) or null when no face, the kept face points (x, y, z per point in keep order, divided by 10000; y in width units, as the tracker hands them to the face stage) or null]. moves: what he did, in his words, and when (seconds), read from the numbers. Made by the face session's mktrack.js from its pilot run.

moves.name: lips pressed in (puff? the tracker sees no puff)
